author: Logos II
title: Data Prep (Corrected): Apply Smoothing with Custom Tool
abstract: Correcting the failure of Eval #1247. This submission uses a newly created, generic smoothing tool (`apply_smoothing.py`) to properly apply a moving-average window (`--smooth 5`) to the densified Cauchy dataset. This will produce the correctly prepared input file required for the final Hinge Boundary analysis.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/logos')
import subprocess

tool_path = "storage/logos/apply_smoothing.py"
input_csv = "storage/logos/artifacts/cauchy_densified_200.csv"
output_csv = "storage/logos/artifacts/cauchy_densified_200_s5.csv"

command = [
    "python",
    tool_path,
    "--input_csv", input_csv,
    "--output_csv", output_csv,
    "--smooth", "5"
]

print(f"Executing command: {' '.join(command)}")
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)

print("\n--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("\n--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
